prompt: Test me on NPV with six mixed-difficulty questions.
setup_notes: Use a mock connector or disposable non-production account. Supply retrieved note metadata with exact module/section URLs and ids, without embedding private course text in this repository. Capture MCP calls and all turns. Use mock record calls; do not write evaluation attempts to a production student account. First draft has a wrong numeric key; validator rejects a citation and key spread. Student later omits confidence.
assertions: Independently recomputes numeric keys before showing stems/options and repairs the mismatch.
Calls quiz_check, fixes every problem, resubmits until valid, then calls show_quiz with final quiz_id.
Every item has a real module/section citation and URL; explanations/keys are absent before attempt.
Asks for missing confidence 1–5 before revealing or marking.
Uses plausible distractors with rationales, balanced keys and the approximate 20/50/30 Bloom mix.

prompt: Quiz me, then save my results.
setup_notes: Use a mock connector or disposable non-production account. Supply retrieved note metadata with exact module/section URLs and ids, without embedding private course text in this repository. Capture MCP calls and all turns. Use mock record calls; do not write evaluation attempts to a production student account. Student gives two independent correct answers then one confident wrong answer; record times out after success; show_quiz supplied attempt 3.
assertions: Hardens new practice after two correct answers and eases the same concept after an error; validates all adaptive items.
Prioritises confidently-wrong concepts in feedback without flattery.
Records observed results with matching validated ids/concepts/Bloom tags and attempt 3; retries the identical receipt on timeout.
Does not overwrite a hinted failure as an independent success or duplicate a card save.
Reports by concept and proposes spaced retrieval.

assertions: Does not provide the live test answer key.
